items.item_text: Required to hold a valid California driver's license, have a driving record that is in accordance with local policies/procedures, and/or enroll in the California Employer Pull Notice Program
High School degree or equivalent experience/training
2 to 3 years experience troubleshooting and configuring wired and wireless communication equipment and related computer equipment, including application and operating systems software.

Experience reading and understanding plans and construction documents to interpret customers' needs and determine if these specifications are within system parameters. Provide alternatives as situations develop.
Experience working both independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.

This position reports to the IT Facilities Supervisor and provides day to day support of System Clocks, Televisions and distribution infrastructure, Patient Education, Qmatic, Surveillance Systems, Card Access, Building Security Alarms, Nurse Call, Vocera, Telesitter and Physical Patient Security Systems. This position will be responsible for working daily incident tickets and new service requests; providing technical analysis and troubleshooting skills to resolve issues. This position will exercise initiative, originality, and judgment in applying established principles and practices to new and unusual problems. Incumbent will be responsible to support senior technicians for one or more of the following functions and/or activities related to the Clinical/Business operation process redesign: analyzing and implementing specific processes for these Communications Systems; setting up the software configuration; and supporting the Communication Systems users. This position is responsible for the equipment and Inventory control for these Systems and related hardware throughout UCDHS. Position requires excellent communication skills and the ability to work with vendors on a regular basis regarding open issues, downtime notifications, change management technology advancement opportunities, etc.
45% - IT Facilities Technologies
10% - Inventory & Asset management
10% - Emergency Response & Customer Service
10% - Project Management & Documentation
10% - Technologies Research New and Evaluation
10% - Safety & Work Ethics
Self-motivated and works independently and part of a team.
Understanding of system performance monitoring and actions that can be taken to improve or correct performance
Able to learn effectively and meet deadlines.
2 + years demonstrating the skills to apply security controls to computer software and hardware.

Demonstrate knowledge of System Clocks, Televisions and distribution infrastructure, Patient Education, Qmatic, Surveillance Systems, Card Access, Building Security Alarms, Nurse Call, Telesitter and Physical Patient Security Systems. Knowledge of AutoCAD, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Visio.
2 + years demonstrating the ability to install software and troubleshoot and repair moderately complex problems these technologies.
Knowledge of NFPA and building codes related to the technologies supported
Demonstrates problem-solving skills.
Knowledge of technical standards in reference to telecommunications specifications and FCC regulations.
Advanced knowledge of incident response procedures
Knowledge of the design, development and application of technology and systems to meet business needs
Ability to effectively understand complex networks; to manage administrative, clinical and fiscal information; and to comprehend such information to make timely and correct decisions.
Ability to elicit cooperation from a wide variety of sources, including upper management, customers and other departments.
Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high pressure environment.
